eligibility.reason: The nominated direct kobuki_node/android_app_manager pair does not represent both failures under the one-composition rule. A separately launched diagnostic_aggregator node publishes the dashboard input, and the status-name fix changes that node's configuration. The key-value fix instead changes kobuki_node. Locating the aggregator's configuration in the kobuki repository does not merge this separate ROS node into kobuki_node under E2. E1 and E4 are supported, but step 1 needs an explicit re-scoped composition rather than silently treating three nodes as two.

failed_conditions.quote: I modified diagnostics.yaml to remove the node name (by adding remove_prefix: mobile_base)
failed_conditions.reason: As a factual payload mismatch, the named status/topic elements and other class are supported. This does not endorse attributing the aggregator's output directly to kobuki_node. The consumer code explicitly matches /Power System/Battery.

failed_conditions.quote: We send Current Charge and Capacity diagnostic values. See /kobuki_node/src/node/diagnostics.cpp
failed_conditions.reason: The diff adds the three payload keys used by the dashboard; these are semantic KeyValue contents rather than renamed ROS message fields or nominal message types. The class and elements are supported independently of the composition objection.

resolution.reason: The maintainer supports the repair and describes its intended/correct display behavior, but neither names a tested Android application revision nor demonstrates the specified inferred app checkout with the patched provider. A fix declaration alone does not meet the strict revision-identified observed criterion.

notes: Read issue #136 and its complete comment, the fix diff, parent launch files and the pinned dashboard source. Condition judgments describe documented payload defects; eligibility is a separate objection to their aggregation into the declared two-unit pair. The maintainer's hard-coded charger/battery caveats are conditional limitations, not evidence that another failure was observed with this composition. No new failed condition is asserted from them.
